story.title: About Me
story.headline2: I design fast, scalable web experiences.
story.paragraph: I'm a fullstack web developer based in Yogyakarta building end-to-end web products—from clean UI and precise interactions to reliable backend systems. Experienced in company profiles, operational dashboards, and data-driven applications.
story.quote: "Good UI is obvious. Great engineering is invisible."

portfolio.title: Selected Work
portfolio.sabanaDesc: Capstone Asah Dicoding — Dual-sided PWA for outdoor gear rental operations in Sleman, Yogyakarta. Combines a staff dashboard (WhatsApp order extraction & warehouse stock) with a public rental catalog & booking tracker.
portfolio.scholarifyDesc: Company profile website and SNBT tryout platform with professional data analysis to support student evaluation and decision-making.
portfolio.airaDesc: Online booking system & company profile for Aira Dry Cleaning — customers can check pricing, pickup/delivery schedules, and location without messaging first.
portfolio.customDesc: Need a company profile, operational dashboard, WhatsApp AI chatbot integration, or payment gateway? Let's engineer a clean, production-ready system.

services.title: Services
services.description: End-to-end delivery for web products: modern UI, reliable backend, and production-ready deployments.
services.webDevDesc: End-to-end websites and web apps — auth, dashboards, admin panels, and API integrations.
services.uiUxDesc: Modern, responsive interfaces built with accessibility and performance in mind.
services.backendDesc: REST APIs, database design, query optimization, and maintainable backend architecture.
services.deploymentDesc: Hosting/cloud deployment, environment setup, monitoring, and post-launch maintenance.
services.chatbotDesc: AI chatbot integration for automated 24/7 customer replies without manual standby.
services.paymentDesc: Online payment integration (Midtrans, Xendit, etc.) directly into your website or store.
